{{Quote|The Quarren's ship was overdue on docking fees, so I had Lorrb put an impoundment transmitter on it.|Darial Anglethorn|<ref name="blood" />}}
'''Inpoundment transmitters''' were a type of [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] placed inside the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] of those who failed to pay docking fees at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beheboth]].<ref name="blood" /> Around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040603beheboth1|series=Beheboth: Blood and Water|text=Part 1: Return to Prosperity}} dates the events of ''[[Beheboth: Blood and Water]]'' to a few [[Standard month|months]] after the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|wedding]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. As ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the wedding to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], ''Beheboth: Blood and Water''&mdash;which includes [[Beheboth: Blood and Water|''Hit and Mist'']]&mdash;must also take place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Kimp Minmirn]] found himself in this situation and a beacon was installed by a spaceport worker named [[Lorrb]]. [[Peacekeeper (Prosperity)|Peacekeeper]] [[Darial Anglethorn]] and the Beheboth [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] later used this to track the fugitive [[Mils Giel]], who [[Thief/Legends|stole]] Minmirn's vessel to flee the planet after being caught [[Mutant|mutating]] the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Tirrith]] population into his personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="blood" />

==Behind the scenes==
An impoundment transmitter was mentioned in part four of ''[[Beheboth: Blood and Water]]'', [[Beheboth: Blood and Water|''Hit and Mist'']], a supplement to the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]]. The [[Planet Hoppers]] serial article was written by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and released on [[June 24]], [[2004]].<ref name="blood" />
